# Practice Task WorkOrder instructions

Read `SKILL.md`, `通用提示词.md`, and `简介.md` before generating a WorkOrder. Practice Task Contract V1 is the upstream fact source: preserve its identity, lesson IDs, hours, deliverables, criteria, tools/materials, and safety/compliance constraints. Do not generate teacher answers; keep task results blank; retain attendance 10, task items 90, and total 100; then run WorkOrder Content QA, Cross-Artifact QA, and Output QA.
